This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand gives you four arms to separate towels and rotate them for easy access, while the heavy base is weighted to help prevent tipping.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Protect floors and counters with a felt pad on the base
- Choose a look that coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware, with multiple designer finish options
- Coordinate with the Soho collection for a matching Soho bathroom setup

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass construction (solid brass)
- Overall size: 12 in L x 49 in H x 9.25 in W
- Base/rod diameter: 1 in
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Mounting type: freestanding vertical stand
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Includes: towel stand
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
